請問如何用 R 將此資料繪圖如 excel 的雙軸圖? (如附件)
謝謝!!

messages.author: 80f300805059bdc2
messages.subject: Re: graphic
parts:
可參考下列方式
 
excel <- readWorksheetFromFile('example.xlsx',sheet='工作表1')

Black <- as.table(excel$Black)
names(Black) <- excel$State
White <- as.table(excel$White)
names(White) <- excel$State
Percentage <- as.table(excel$Percentage)
names(Percentage) <- excel$State

BW <- rbind(Black,White)

Bar <- barplot(BW, beside=T, col=c("skyblue1", "salmon"))
par(new=T)
plot(Percentage,type="l", axes=F,ylab="", ylim=c(0,0.3),col="green3")
points(Percentage,type="o",pch=17,col="green3")
axis(4)

legend("top",c("Black", "White","Percentage"),col=c("skyblue1", "salmon","green3"), ncol=1, pch=c(15,15,17),lty=c(0,0,1),cex=0.7)
